versions.subject: Added rule for Atlassian Confluence CVE-2021-26084
versions.detection:
selection:
    # Monitor suspicious child processes spawned by Confluence
    ParentImage|endswith: '\Atlassian\Confluence\jre\bin\java.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'cmd /c'
      - 'cmd /k'
      - 'powershell'
      - 'certutil'
      - 'curl'
      - 'whoami'
      - 'ipconfig'
condition: selection
